bounded_interpretable_result.note: These five cases do not override the formal aggregate BLOCKED decision.

formal_blocker.reason: Recomputed C4L cubic summary misses the preregistered 1e-10 cm/day reproduction gate.

scientific_interpretation: C4M is formally blocked by the frozen cubic-reproduction gate in 5 cm HOLD; the gate is not relaxed post response.
The C4L, B9, B8 and B7 source blobs are bit-identical to the C4L authority, so the miss is classified as run-to-run numerical reproducibility rather than provenance drift.
In every one of the five otherwise interpretable cases, the parameter-free central interface gradient is not supported relative to B9.
The central slope generally over-applies the available terminal-to-bulk slope contrast. This motivates an independent response-blind amplitude-geometry test, not a fitted blend.
